Maintenance release adding signed and notarized downloads and improving notification permission handling.

## Highlights

- Signed and notarized both Apple Silicon and Intel downloads with Developer ID, including stapled notarization tickets on the app and DMG.
- Updated notification settings to reflect macOS permissions, explain when notifications are blocked, and provide a shortcut to Notification Settings.
- Preserved saved notification choices while permission is disabled and restored them when permission is granted again.
- Kept notification preference changes immediate when permission is already granted.
- Refreshed alert state when permission changes so usage-limit and low-credit alerts resume correctly.
- Hardened release signing and notarization to keep credentials and raw responses out of CI logs and artifacts.
